title: 8,000 years of ceremonial-site artifacts documented by archaeologist Chris Roberts
summary: Brandon Fugal tells of 8,000 years of ceremonial-site artifacts documented by archaeologist Chris Roberts, about 8,000 years ago to present at Skinwalker Ranch, Utah, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: our archaeologist, Chris Roberts, has now documented going back over 8,000 years of artifacts

plain: Brandon Fugal owns Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah long tied to reports of strange lights and events. He says the ranch's archaeologist, Chris Roberts, has documented artifacts there going back more than 8,000 years, from what Fugal treats as a ceremonial site. If so, it would suggest people have treated the place as special for thousands of years.
